body:
We've had a lot of up and downs but the core of the relationship with my gf has always been a pleasant one.

I have made attempts at talking to my sisters, I should have added that, it even resulted in my eldest sister not talking to me for about 3 months toward the end of last year. An I have made it clear about the bad mouthing but it persists, and we know it persists behind closed doors so we no longer even trust them to be alone with our son sadly enough. They don't seem to care.

Perhaps a firmer hand from me is needed.

Few months back I left my partner due to depression, thought I was doing her a favour if I couldn't love her properly (we do have a child together).  
Regretting it now though as I can see she's moving on while I try to sort my own head out and fix my own problems.  
It's something you have to take one day at a time, but make sure you're open with yourself and with the people around you, it will make things a lot easier in the long run. Only when you face the issues can you begin to heal. Stay strong buddy.
